Disallow: /aws/en/search-for
Disallow: /aws/ja/search-for
Disallow: /aws/pt/search-for

Disallow: /gcp/en/search-for
Disallow: /gcp/ja/search-for
Disallow: /gcp/pt/search-for

# Allow crawling of language-specific directories
Allow: /aws/en/
Allow: /aws/ja/
Allow: /aws/pt/

Allow: /gcp/en/
Allow: /gcp/ja/
Allow: /gcp/pt/

# Hide archived docs from search indexers
Disallow: /aws/en/archive/
Disallow: /aws/ja/archive/
Disallow: /aws/pt/archive/

Disallow: /gcp/en/archive/
Disallow: /gcp/ja/archive/
Disallow: /gcp/pt/archive/
